Distrib.description: A distribution to build for, keyed by its id (``debian``, ``fedora``).

extra_repositories.description: The repositories of other packages its builds depend on, signature-checked.
extra_repositories.title: Extra Repositories

gpg.description: The key that signs its packages and repository.

repository.description: The repository its packages are published in.

versions.description:
The releases to build for: codenames, versions, ``supported``, ``testing``, ``sid``,
``all``, and ``available``, which keeps only those whose builder image is published.
versions.title: Versions

Distrib.title: Distrib

ExtraRepository.description:
A signed repository of other packages the builds depend on (another project's).

The builds install from it with a lower precedence than the project's own packages, and the
repository's page tells its users to add it first.

components.description: The components of a Debian family repository.
components.title: Components

key.description: The file of the public key that signs it, relative to build.conf's directory.
key.title: Key

key_url.description: The URL its users download that key from, for the page.
key_url.title: Key Url

name.description: Its short name, in the file names of its configuration (default: extra-<its index>).
name.title: Name

suite.description: The suite of a Debian family repository, a template as url.
suite.title: Suite

url.description:
Its URL: of the whole repository for the Debian family, of a release's directory for the
rpm families; ``{codename}``, ``{version}`` and ``{suite}`` are replaced from the release. A
``file://`` URL names a directory of the build's host, mounted into the build.
url.title: Url

ExtraRepository.title: ExtraRepository

Gpg.description: The OpenPGP key that signs a distribution's packages and repository.

file.description: The file holding the secret key, relative to build.conf's directory.
file.title: File

id.description: The fingerprint or key ID of the key to use, when the file holds several.
id.title: Id

uid.description: The user ID of the key to use, in the changelog entries (default: the key's first one).
uid.title: Uid

Gpg.title: Gpg

Package.description:
A package to build, keyed by the name of its directory.

The directory holds ``debian/`` for the Debian family, ``<name>.spec`` for the Fedora family,
or both. A 3.0 (quilt) deb source downloads its upstream tarball as ``debian/watch`` says; an
rpm, as its spec's ``Source:`` lines say.

disable.description: The releases, per distribution id, not to build this package for (release tokens).
disable.title: Disable

Package.title: Package

Repository.description: The repository the packages of a distribution are published in.

description.description: The repository's label, in its Release file and its .repo file (default: its name).
description.title: Description

name.description:
The repository's short name, in the keyring and .repo file names (default: the URL's last
path component).
name.title: Name

path.description: Where the repository is written, relative to build.conf's directory.
path.title: Path

url.description: The URL the repository is served from; without it, no installation page is written.
url.title: Url

Repository.title: Repository

distribs.description: The distributions to build for, keyed by id.
distribs.title: Distribs

packages.description: The packages to build, keyed by the name of their directory, beside build.conf.
packages.title: Packages
